name: Signate Melanolophia
desc: Signate Melanolophia (Melanolophia signataria): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Melanolophia signataria, the signate melanolophia, is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Nova Scotia to Florida, west to Saskatchewan and East Texas.
